item.title: She Crashed Her Car And Vanished Before Police Arrived
item.description: Maura Murray disappeared in New Hampshire in 2004 after her car went off a snowy road. A passerby spoke with her, but when police arrived minutes later, she was gone. More than 20 years later, no confirmed trace of her has been found and the case remains open.

item.title: Was Frank Abagnale’s Greatest Con His Own Story?
item.description: Frank Abagnale became famous for claims that he posed as a pilot, doctor and lawyer while passing fraudulent checks. But later investigations and public records challenged major parts of his Catch Me If You Can story, suggesting many of his most famous exploits may never have happened.

item.title: His Crashed Car Was Found But Bryce Was Gone
item.description: Bryce Laspisa vanished in 2013 while driving home from college in California. His SUV was found crashed near Castaic Lake with his phone, wallet and laptop still inside, but there was no sign of Bryce. Despite extensive searches, he remains missing.

item.title: Her Boyfriend Was Convicted 10 Years After She Vanished
item.description: Crystal Rogers disappeared from Bardstown, Kentucky, in 2015, and her car was later found abandoned with her belongings inside. Her body has never been found. In 2025, former boyfriend Brooks Houck was convicted of her murder and later sentenced to life in prison.

item.title: Her Husband Was Wanted For Murder When Police Closed In
item.description: Influencer Alexis Sharkey was found dead beside a Houston road in November 2020, and an autopsy determined she had been strangled. Police later named her husband, Tom Sharkey, as the murder suspect. He died by suicide in 2021 as authorities moved to arrest him.

item.title: He Entered An Underwater Cave And Was Never Found
item.description: Ben McDaniel was last seen entering the underwater cave at Florida’s Vortex Spring in August 2010. Extensive searches reached deep into the cave but found no body or clear evidence of where he went. His disappearance remains unsolved.
